Viral posts discuss job satisfaction and financial realities of high earners

Several individuals have recently gained online attention for sharing their financial situations and career dissatisfaction. These stories, circulating widely on social media, highlight a disconnect between high salaries and personal fulfillment, prompting discussions about lifestyle inflation, work pressure, and career choices. The narratives explore the emotional and psychological impact of corporate life, even for those earning substantial incomes.
